messages.text: Will a power spike fry the whole miner?

The built-in PSU (GM-H250S12) accepts **100–264V AC, 47–63Hz** — that wide input range handles most voltage swings automatically.

For extra peace of mind:
- A **basic surge protector** ($10–15) covers spike protection
- A **UPS** adds clean power + battery backup if outages are a concern

The P. itself is a quality switch-mode unit rated **>94% efficiency** — it's not a cheap brick. That said, no electronics are immune to a direct lightning strike or catastrophic surge, so a surge protector is just good practice with any miner.
